The off-market CRE problem

Relevant capital and inventory are already there.
The connection is not.

European commercial real estate remains fragmented, relationship-driven and sensitive to trust. Buyers face noise. Brokers face exposure. Both sides need a more controlled way to test fit before identity is revealed.

What Actium CRE is

A private transaction layer for
off-market CRE.

Actium CRE is a bilateral off-market transaction engine connecting Buy-Side capital with Sell-Side inventory. Confidential mandates are matched with audited assets through a double-blind Dark Pool.
